title: CounterFlow: Target-Conditioned Flow Matching for Visual Counterfactuals
title_zh: CounterFlow：面向视觉反事实的目标条件流匹配

paragraphs.en: In eXplainable AI, counterfactual explanations have gained significant traction by offering users direct, intuitive, and actionable insights into model decisions. We introduce CounterFlow, a novel framework based on Conditional Flow Matching that generates visual counterfactual explanations by directly steering a source image toward a user-specified target class. By leveraging target-conditioned vector fields, CounterFlow identifies highly realistic semantic modifications while requiring substantially lower computational overhead than traditional GAN- or diffusion-based architectures. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CounterFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in both visual realism and target class switching. By working directly in the raw pixel space, CounterFlow offers a more practical solution for real-world deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 在可解释人工智能领域，反事实解释因能为用户提供对模型决策直接、直观且可操作的洞察而获得了广泛关注。 我们提出了 CounterFlow，一个基于条件流匹配的新颖框架，它通过直接将源图像引导至用户指定的目标类别来生成视觉反事实解释。 通过利用目标条件向量场，CounterFlow 能够识别高度逼真的语义修改，同时其计算开销显著低于传统的基于生成对抗网络或扩散模型的架构。 在标准基准上的实证评估表明，CounterFlow 在视觉真实性和目标类别切换两方面均达到了最先进的性能。 由于直接在原始像素空间中工作，CounterFlow 为现实世界的部署提供了更实用的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Context. On the one hand, in generative modeling, diffusion models currently dominate the landscape for high-quality image, video, and audio synthesis ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ho et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023a ) . However, they are also well-known for their slow training times and their stochastic sampling paths. To address these limitations, Lipman et al. (2023) ; Albergo and Vanden-Eijnden (2023) ; Liu et al. (2023b) introduced Conditional Flow Matching (CFM). CFM is a generative modeling framework based on Continuous Normalizing Flows (CNFs) that uses standard regression objectives for training. Moreover, instead of relying on diffusion processes, CFM generates examples by integrating the CNF’s ODE along deterministic trajectories. On the other hand, the generative models’ ability to generate complex data distributions and thus to produce realistic examples is particularly appealing for eXplainable Artificial Intelligence ( Dwivedi et al., 2023 , XAI,) , where one aims to produce counterfactual explanations ( Wachter et al., 2017 ) , i.e. , examples (i) close to a given input, (ii) plausible, and (iii) that change the model’s prediction. Unlike adversarial examples that rely on imperceptible noise to fool the classifier, counterfactual examples expose meaningful changes, helping users to trust the model while enabling developers to debug it. Our work leverages CFM to create counterfactual explanations: rather than generating images from random noise, our approach transports an input sample toward a counterfactual conditioned on a user-defined target class, while jointly optimizing for plausibility and proximity; see Figure 1 .

paragraphs.en: Related Work. Prior work on image counterfactual explanations falls into two categories: instance-based and generative approaches. Instance-based methods ( Goyal et al., 2019 ; Keane and Smyth, 2020 , see e.g. ,) select examples from the training set using similarity metrics to modify the input sample 𝐱 \mathbf{x} . However, they require access to the training set at inference and cannot tailor a minimal, plausible edit to a specific example 𝐱 \mathbf{x} . We focus instead on generative approaches, a more recent line of work ( Khorram and Fuxin, 2022 ; Jeanneret et al., 2024 ; Weng et al., 2024 ; Augustin et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) that produces more plausible examples, which we group by generative backbone: GANs, diffusion models, or CFM.
paragraphs.zh: 相关工作。 之前关于图像反事实解释的工作分为两类：基于实例的方法和生成式方法。 基于实例的方法（Goyal et al., 2019；Keane and Smyth, 2020，例如参见）使用相似度度量从训练集中选取样本来修改输入样本 𝐱 \mathbf{x}。 然而，它们在推理时需要访问训练集，且无法针对特定样本 𝐱 \mathbf{x} 定制最小且合理的编辑。 我们转而关注生成式方法，这是较新的研究方向（Khorram and Fuxin, 2022；Jeanneret et al., 2024；Weng et al., 2024；Augustin et al., 2022；Cao et al., 2025），能生成更合理的样本，我们按生成式骨干将其分为：GAN、扩散模型或 CFM。

paragraphs.en: GAN. C3LT ( Khorram and Fuxin, 2022 ) encodes the input (with a VAE encoder) into a latent space, in which it learns two cycle-consistent transformations per pair of classes ( y , y ′ ) (y,y^{\prime}) before decoding with the generator of a GAN. It thus requires one model set per pair, impractical for many classes, and its fidelity is bounded by the VAE’s reconstruction quality.
paragraphs.zh: GAN（生成对抗网络）。 C3LT（Khorram and Fuxin, 2022）将输入（通过 VAE 编码器）编码到潜在空间中，并在用 GAN 的生成器解码之前，为每一对类别 (y, y′) 学习两个循环一致的变换。 因此它需要为每一对类别准备一组模型，这在类别很多时并不实用，且其保真度受限于 VAE 的重建质量。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion. DiME ( Jeanneret et al., 2024 ) generates a counterfactual by corrupting the input and denoising it through the backward diffusion process (an inner loop of several steps); at each outer step, the classifier gradient computed on this denoised estimate refines the corrupted instance, and the process repeats until it converges to a valid counterfactual. FastDiME ( Weng et al., 2024 ) instead computes this gradient directly from the model’s one-step denoised estimate, bypassing the inner loop entirely. ACE ( Jeanneret et al., 2023 ) takes a different route: it builds an adversarial attack against the classifier and lets the diffusion model’s own denoising process project this attack back onto the manifold of realistic images, turning an imperceptible perturbation into a semantically meaningful one. DVCE ( Augustin et al., 2022 ) starts the reverse diffusion from a partially noised version of the input, rather than pure noise, and steers the process by projecting the gradient of an adversarially robust classifier onto a cone around the target classifier’s own gradient direction whenever the two disagree, avoiding non-semantic changes. More recently, MaskDiME ( Guo et al., 2026 ) improves on DiME’s efficiency and spatial precision with a training-free, adaptive dual-mask mechanism guided by classifier gradients that restricts updates to a localized region rather than the whole image. Regardless of the specific guidance scheme, diffusion-guidance methods must reapply their guidance at every one of many denoising steps, making inference slow: DiME’s inner diffusion loop scales quadratically with the number of diffusion steps, and even FastDiME’s one-step approximation, despite yielding a roughly 20 × \times empirical speedup, only reduces this to a linear scaling and remains markedly slower than a single forward pass. ACE and DVCE compound this same per-step cost further, respectively adding an adversarial attack and a robust-classifier gradient computation at every step.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型。 DiME（Jeanneret 等人，2024）通过破坏输入并经由反向扩散过程对其进行去噪（一个包含多步的内循环）来生成反事实；在每一个外层步骤中，基于该去噪估计计算得到的分类器梯度会修正被破坏的样本，该过程不断重复，直到收敛为一个有效的反事实。 FastDiME（Weng 等人，2024）则直接从模型一步去噪得到的估计中计算该梯度，完全省去了内循环。 ACE（Jeanneret 等人，2023）采取了不同的路径：它针对分类器构建对抗攻击，并让扩散模型自身的去噪过程将该攻击投射回真实图像的流形上，从而把不可感知的扰动转化为语义上有意义的扰动。 DVCE（Augustin 等人，2022）从输入的部分加噪版本而非纯噪声开始反向扩散，并且当两个梯度方向不一致时，通过将对抗鲁棒分类器的梯度投射到目标分类器自身梯度方向周围的锥形区域内来引导该过程，从而避免非语义的变化。 最近，MaskDiME（Guo 等人，2026）通过一种免训练的、由分类器梯度引导的自适应双掩码机制，在 DiME 的效率和空间精度上进行了改进，该机制将更新限制在局部区域而非整幅图像。 无论采用何种具体的引导方案，扩散引导方法都必须在众多去噪步骤中的每一步重新施加引导，导致推理缓慢：DiME 的内层扩散循环随扩散步数呈二次方增长，而即使是 FastDiME 的一步近似，尽管带来了约 20 × \times 倍的经验加速，也仅将其降为线性增长，且仍明显慢于单次前向传播。 ACE 和 DVCE 进一步加剧了同样的每步开销，分别在每一步增加了对抗攻击和鲁棒分类器梯度计算。

paragraphs.en: CFM. LeapFactual ( Cao et al., 2025 ) builds on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) to generate counterfactuals. It learns a class-conditional generative flow from a Gaussian prior to the latent space of a pretrained VAE, and repurposes this flow for counterfactual generation through a lift-and-land procedure. Given an input, its VAE encoding is first lifted toward the prior under the input class by solving the learned ODE backward, and then landed back into the latent space under the target class by solving the ODE forward. This “leap” must be repeated a dataset-dependent number of times, with each leap requiring a VAE decoding and a classifier query.
paragraphs.zh: CFM。 LeapFactual（Cao 等，2025）在条件流匹配（CFM）的基础上构建，用于生成反事实样本。 它学习一个类条件生成流，从高斯先验映射到预训练 VAE 的潜空间，并通过“起跃-降落”（lift-and-land）流程将该流重新用于反事实生成。 给定一个输入，首先通过反向求解所学到的 ODE，将输入的 VAE 编码在输入类别下起跃至先验，然后通过正向求解 ODE，将其在目标类别下降落回潜空间。 这个“跃迁”必须根据数据集重复相应次数，每次跃迁都需要一次 VAE 解码和一次分类器查询。

sents.zh: 它学习一个类条件生成流，从高斯先验映射到预训练 VAE 的潜空间，并通过“起跃-降落”（lift-and-land）流程将该流重新用于反事实生成。

sents.en: Given an input, its VAE encoding is first lifted toward the prior under the input class by solving the learned ODE backward, and then landed back into the latent space under the target class by solving the ODE forward.
sents.zh: 给定一个输入，首先通过反向求解所学到的 ODE，将输入的 VAE 编码在输入类别下起跃至先验，然后通过正向求解 ODE，将其在目标类别下降落回潜空间。

sents.en: This “leap” must be repeated a dataset-dependent number of times, with each leap requiring a VAE decoding and a classifier query.
sents.zh: 这个“跃迁”必须根据数据集重复相应次数，每次跃迁都需要一次 VAE 解码和一次分类器查询。

paragraphs.en: Our work also builds on CFM, but uses it in a fundamentally different way. We directly learn a transport from an input image to its counterfactual. This avoids (i) the need for multiple costly leaps, (ii) the intermediate traversal through a prior space, and (iii) VAE encoding and decoding, whose reconstruction fidelity can limit the quality of the generated counterfactuals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作同样建立在 CFM 之上，但以一种根本不同的方式使用它。 我们直接学习一个从输入图像到其反事实的传输。 这避免了 (i) 多次代价高昂的跳跃的需要，(ii) 经过先验空间的中间遍历，以及 (iii) VAE 的编码和解码，其重建保真度可能限制所生成反事实的质量。

paragraphs.en: We introduce CounterFlow, the first CFM framework that directly conditions the vector field on both the source and target class, enabling a single model to transport examples between any pair of classes in their original pixel representation. Moreover, CounterFlow generates a counterfactual by integrating a single (learned) ODE from source to target, with no additional VAE decoding or iterative optimization at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 CounterFlow，这是首个将向量场直接同时条件化于源类别与目标类别的 CFM 框架，使单一模型能够在任意一对类别之间以原始像素表示的形式传输样本。 此外，CounterFlow 通过从源到目标积分单个（可学习的）ODE 来生成反事实，在推理时无需额外的 VAE 解码或迭代优化。

paragraphs.en: To enable the learning of the transport map, we introduce two complementary contributions: a latent-space nearest-neighbor pairing strategy and an auxiliary classification loss. The pairing algorithm leverages the embedding space of a pretrained VAE to associate each source example with a semantically similar target example, thereby reducing the transport distance that the flow must learn. The auxiliary classification loss further guides the flow toward transformations that induce the desired change in the classifier’s prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现传输映射的学习，我们引入了两项互补的贡献：一种潜空间最近邻配对策略和一个辅助分类损失。 该配对算法利用预训练 VAE 的嵌入空间，将每个源样本与语义相似的目标样本相关联，从而缩小流必须学习的传输距离。 辅助分类损失进一步引导流向能够使分类器预测产生期望变化的变换。

These two datasets provide complementary evaluation settings, ranging from a simple handwritten digit classification task to a natural image classification benchmark. For all experiments, we use the standard training and test splits provided with each dataset. Section A.4 discusses why we do not extend the comparison to larger benchmarks such as ImageNet.

paragraphs.en: Methods. We compare CounterFlow 2 2 2 The hyperparameters of CounterFlow are listed in Appendix. against three recent counterfactual generation methods: C3LT ( Khorram and Fuxin, 2022 ) , FastDiME ( Weng et al., 2024 ) , and LeapFactual ( Cao et al., 2025 ) , where we use the official implementations. Among diffusion-guidance methods, we retain only FastDiME as a representative baseline: DiME and ACE are prohibitively expensive to run at scale due to their inner-loop or per-step attack computations; DVCE requires an adversarially robust classifier, a constraint that our method does not rely on and that we therefore do not impose in our experiments; and MaskDiME’s masking mechanism restricts edits to a localized region, which conflicts with our evaluation setting where the change may need to affect the whole image. Beyond this choice, neither of the two remaining baselines, namely LeapFactual and FastDiME, is applicable to both datasets. LeapFactual relies on a compact VAE latent space to remain tractable, which does not scale to CIFAR-10 without dominant reconstruction artifacts and a much costlier latent flow, so we evaluate it only on MNIST. Conversely, FastDiME depends on pretrained OpenAI diffusion models built for natural images, so we evaluate it only on CIFAR-10.

paragraphs.en: Conditional Validity measures the proportion (in %) of generated counterfactuals x 1 x_{1} that are classified as the desired target class y 1 y_{1} , i.e. , whether we have f ⁡ ( 𝐱 1 ) = y 1 f(\mathbf{x}_{1})=y_{1} .

paragraphs.en: FID t computes the Fréchet Inception Distance between the generated counterfactuals and real samples from the target class, quantifying realism : lower values indicate that the generated samples better match the distribution of the desired class.

paragraphs.en: FID s computes the Fréchet Inception Distance between the generated counterfactuals and the original source class, measuring proximity to the source : lower values indicate that the counterfactuals remain closer to the original data distribution, suggesting that fewer semantic changes were applied to reach the target class.

paragraphs.en: Following the standard definition of the Fréchet Inception Distance ( Heusel et al., 2017 , FID,) , feature statistics for FID t and FID s are extracted from pretrained image classification networks. For CIFAR-10, we use the pretrained Inception-V3 network available in torchvision . Since ImageNet-pretrained models are not well suited for handwritten digit recognition, for MNIST we instead compute features using the pretrained convolutional classifier employed throughout our experiments. FID is then computed between the Gaussian statistics of the extracted features from the generated counterfactuals and those of the corresponding source or target class, i.e. , FID t on the target class and FID s on the source class. Note that, since these statistics are estimated from the subset of test examples belonging to a single class, rather than from the full test set as in standard, unconditional FID computations, the reported values are higher than those typically observed in unconditional image generation. We therefore focus on relative comparisons between methods under the same evaluation protocol rather than on the absolute reported numbers.
paragraphs.zh: 根据 Fréchet Inception Distance（Heusel et al., 2017，FID）的标准定义，FID_t 和 FID_s 的特征统计量是从预训练的图像分类网络中提取的。 对于 CIFAR-10，我们使用 torchvision 中提供的预训练 Inception-V3 网络。 由于在 ImageNet 上预训练的模型并不适合手写数字识别，对于 MNIST，我们改为使用贯穿本文实验的预训练卷积分类器来计算特征。 然后在从生成的反事实样本中提取的特征的高斯统计量与对应源类别或目标类别的统计量之间计算 FID，即在目标类别上计算 FID_t，在源类别上计算 FID_s。 请注意，由于这些统计量是从属于单一类别的测试样本子集估计得到的，而不是像标准无条件下 FID 计算那样从完整测试集估计得到的，因此所报告的数值高于在无条件图像生成中通常观察到的数值。 因此，我们关注的是在同一评估协议下方法之间的相对比较，而不是所报告的绝对数值。

paragraphs.en: CIFAR-10. FastDiME reaches only 16 % 16\% conditional validity despite a diffusion backbone 900 × 900\times more expensive per sample, and has the worst FID on both axes; with so few samples switching class, these scores reflect generic realism rather than class transfer.

paragraphs.en: Ablation. Table 1(b) shows that replacing latent-space pairing with random pairing consistently lowers conditional validity and raises both target and source FID on both datasets, mostly through the source FID on CIFAR-10. Pairing semantically similar examples yields simpler transport trajectories that are easier for the conditional velocity field to approximate, whereas random pairing often associates visually unrelated samples, leading to harder-to-learn trajectories and lower-quality counterfactuals. paragraphs.en: Style Preservation. Figure 1 shows five source/counterfactual pairs per dataset. On MNIST, CounterFlow preserves writer-specific style, such as stroke thickness and slant – e.g. , the 4 → 5 4{\to}5 transition retains the source’s thin strokes – and keeps the digit’s orientation, rather than collapsing to a generic class prototype. paragraphs.en: Trajectories. Figure 2 visualizes the full integration trajectory for five counterfactuals per dataset, with the border color marking the classifier’s prediction at each step ( red for the source class, green for the target class). In most examples the color flips early, showing that CounterFlow reaches the target class within a small fraction of the path and spends the remaining steps refining the sample within that class rather than driving the decision itself, i.e. , most of the trajectory makes the class change plausible rather than induces it. Intermediate frames stay visually close to both endpoints rather than passing through a degraded intermediate state, confirming at a finer granularity that CounterFlow produces minimal, semantically meaningful edits rather than an unconstrained image-to-image mapping. See Figures 4 and 5 in Section A.5 for additional CounterFlow trajectories.

paragraphs.en: Existing image counterfactual generation methods often require heavy generative backbones, including diffusion models or multiple class-specific generative networks, making their deployment computationally demanding. CounterFlow demonstrates that Conditional Flow Matching provides a significantly simpler alternative. By learning a single target-conditioned transport field and requiring only one ODE integration at inference, our method achieves competitive or superior counterfactual quality while substantially reducing computational complexity. We believe this constitutes an important step toward making counterfactual explanations practical for interactive decision-support systems, where explanations must be generated quickly and consistently.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的图像反事实生成方法通常需要庞大的生成骨干网络，包括扩散模型或多个特定类别的生成网络，这使得其部署在计算上开销很大。 CounterFlow 证明了条件流匹配提供了一种明显更简单的替代方案。 通过学习单个以目标为条件的传输场，并且推理时只需一次 ODE 积分，我们的方法在获得有竞争力甚至更优的反事实质量的同时，大幅降低了计算复杂度。 我们相信，这是让反事实解释在实际交互式决策支持系统中落地应用的重要一步，因为在这类系统中，解释必须快速且一致地生成。

paragraphs.en: Despite these encouraging results, several limitations remain. First, our experiments are restricted to relatively low-resolution image datasets. Evaluating CounterFlow on larger-scale benchmarks such as ImageNet or high-resolution generative datasets would provide further evidence of its scalability. Second, our latent-space pairing strategy currently relies on nearest-neighbor retrieval using a pretrained encoder, which introduces an additional preprocessing step. Finally, while Conditional Flow Matching substantially reduces inference complexity compared to diffusion models, solving an ODE remains more expensive than a single feed-forward network.

paragraphs.en: We presented CounterFlow, a Conditional Flow Matching framework for visual counterfactual explanation generation. Unlike previous approaches relying on GANs or diffusion models, CounterFlow directly learns a target-conditioned transport field between image classes in pixel space. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art counterfactual validity while remaining competitive in image realism and substantially reducing computational requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CounterFlow，一个用于视觉反事实解释生成的条件流匹配框架。 与以往依赖 GAN 或扩散模型的方法不同，CounterFlow 直接在像素空间中学习图像类别之间的目标条件传输场。 在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上的实验表明，所提出的方法在保持图像真实感具有竞争力的同时，实现了最先进的反事实有效性，并大幅降低了计算需求。

paragraphs.en: Beyond counterfactual explanations, CounterFlow illustrates that target-conditioned flow matching can efficiently learn semantic transformations directly between complex data distributions, without relying on an intermediate noise distribution. Future work will investigate its application to larger-scale datasets and other data transformation tasks, including domain adaptation, semantic image editing, and robust model analysis.

paragraphs.en: This work introduces a method for generating visual counterfactual explanations of image classifiers, evaluated on the standard MNIST and CIFAR-10 benchmarks, which do not contain personal or sensitive data. As with other counterfactual-explanation and image-editing methods, the underlying generative technology could in principle be misused to produce misleading edited images of real people; we mitigate this risk by restricting our experiments to non-human-identifying benchmark datasets and by releasing the method as a tool for model interpretability rather than for unconstrained image generation.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作提出了一种为图像分类器生成视觉反事实解释的方法，并在标准的 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 基准数据集上进行评估，这些数据集不包含个人或敏感数据。 与其他反事实解释和图像编辑方法一样，其底层的生成技术原则上可能被滥用来制作真实人物的误导性编辑图像；我们通过将实验限制在不涉及人类身份识别的基准数据集上，并将该方法作为模型可解释性工具而非无限制的图像生成工具发布，来缓解这一风险。

paragraphs.en: We describe the CounterFlow training and inference procedures in full in Section 4 , including the pairing algorithm ( Algorithm 1 ) and the training loop ( Algorithm 2 ). All training hyperparameters for both datasets are listed in Table 2 in the appendix. paragraphs.en: Explained classifier. A counterfactual method should not depend on the specific classifier it explains. Table 5 therefore keeps CounterFlow unchanged and only substitutes f f , comparing the RepVGG-A2 used throughout the paper with a deliberately mis-specified variant, namely the same network evaluated without its input normalization, which drops its accuracy to 86.3 % 86.3\% , and with an adversarially robust PreActResNet-18 ( Gowal et al., 2021 ) . The mis-specified classifier is explained as well as the original one: validity stays at 100 % 100\% and both FID scores remain within two points of the default, indicating that CounterFlow does not require the explained model to be accurate, only that it defines an exploitable decision boundary. The robust classifier behaves differently: validity drops to 83.5 % 83.5\% , while FID t reaches the lowest value we observe ( 55.72 55.72 ). This is consistent with what adversarial training is designed to achieve, namely flattening the decision boundary and suppressing the small non-robust directions that a gradient-based guidance term can exploit, so that ℒ Cla \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Cla}} pushes less strongly and a fraction of the samples never crosses the boundary. The counterfactuals that do cross must therefore carry a genuine, large-scale semantic change, which is what brings them closer to the target distribution; note that the 16.5 % 16.5\% of samples that remain in the source class can only inflate FID t , so this value is, if anything, pessimistic. Explaining a robust model is thus harder for CounterFlow, but yields more plausible counterfactuals, which is coherent with diffusion-based methods that explicitly require an adversarially robust classifier ( Augustin et al., 2022 ) .

paragraphs.en: Baselines. C3LT requires a separate model for each pair of classes, i.e. , 499,500 499{,}500 models for the 1,000 1{,}000 classes of ImageNet. Hence, its ImageNet experiments are qualitative, restricted to five pairs of classes, and use latent codes sampled from a pretrained GAN rather than real images ( Khorram and Fuxin, 2022 ) . LeapFactual relies on a latent space in which inputs can be faithfully encoded, and each of its leaps requires decoding the latent code and querying the classifier; its only large-scale experiment is a binary task on images generated by a pretrained GAN ( Cao et al., 2025 ) . Diffusion-based methods do apply to ImageNet, but at a high cost: on CIFAR-10, FastDiME already requires about 900 × 900\times more FLOPs per counterfactual than CounterFlow ( Table 1(a) ), and ACE is evaluated on only three pairs of ImageNet classes ( Jeanneret et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 C3LT 需要为每一对类别单独建立一个模型，即在 ImageNet 的 1{,}000 个类别上需要 499{,}500 个模型。 因此，其在 ImageNet 上的实验仅是定性的，局限于五对类别，并且使用从预训练 GAN 中采样的潜码而非真实图像（Khorram and Fuxin, 2022）。 LeapFactual 依赖于一个能够忠实编码输入的潜空间，且其每一步跳跃都需要对潜码进行解码并查询分类器；其唯一的大规模实验是基于预训练 GAN 生成图像的二分类任务（Cao et al., 2025）。 基于扩散的方法虽然可以应用于 ImageNet，但代价高昂：在 CIFAR-10 上，FastDiME 每个反事实所需的 FLOPs 已经约为 CounterFlow 的 900\times 倍（Table 1(a)），而 ACE 仅在三对 ImageNet 类别上进行了评估（Jeanneret et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: CounterFlow. In principle, CounterFlow applies to ImageNet by adapting its U-Net architecture. However, unlike the baselines, which build on generative models pretrained at a considerable computational cost, CounterFlow would have to be trained from scratch in pixel space, which exceeds our computational budget. Moreover, the number of source–target contexts ( y 0 , y 1 ) (y_{0},y_{1}) grows quadratically with the number of classes, so that each context would be seen less often during training. We leave this large-scale study to future work.
paragraphs.zh: CounterFlow。 原则上，CounterFlow 可以通过调整其 U-Net 架构来应用于 ImageNet。 然而，与那些基于以相当大的计算成本预训练的生成模型的基线方法不同，CounterFlow 需要在像素空间中从头训练，这超出了我们的计算预算。 此外，源-目标上下文（ y 0 , y 1 ）(y_{0},y_{1}) 的数量随类别数呈二次增长，因此每个上下文在训练中被看到的次数会更少。 我们将这一大规模研究留待未来工作。
